_comment: League handicap charts, keyed by system then game format (8ball = games needed to win, 9ball = points needed to win). Edit freely - the app fetches this file at runtime, so changes take effect on next reload with no code changes needed. A chart is either per player ({"SL": target}) or for two players ({"your SL": {"opponent's SL": [your target, their target]}}, like APA 8-Ball). A Skill Level missing from a chart (or an empty chart, like bca/vnba/tap start with below) falls back to the league's own 'Base Games to Win' setting. APA's numbers are its real, published nationwide charts (see _sources); BCA, VNBA and TAP don't publish one universal chart (each local league/operator sets its own), so those start empty for you to fill in with your own league's posted numbers.

_sources.apa.8ball: APA 8-Ball Games Must Win Chart (singles, Skill Levels 2-7), APA Official Team Manual, The Equalizer Handicap System > Games Must Win Charts: https://rules.poolplayers.com/the-equalizer-handicap-system/games-must-win-charts/ - all 36 cells checked against APA's chart image on 2026-10-28; none unverified.
_sources.apa.9ball: APA 9-Ball Points Required To Win Chart (Skill Levels 1-9), same page - all 9 values checked on 2026-10-28.
